standard.summary: 让 PyTorch 优化器的 step 走 Triton 内核后端（非顶栏 TurboCore CUDA 路径）。off=原生 step；auto=支持则加速；force=强制（不支持则报错）。与顶栏 TurboCore CUDA 硬互斥：顶栏开时本项强制 off。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.off: 优化器 step 走原生 PyTorch。
optionDescriptions.auto: 条件够就走 Lulynx Triton 优化器。
optionDescriptions.force: 硬走 Triton；环境不够会直接挂。（本选择器里没有：force 在原生模块缺失或优化器不受支持时会直接抛错中断训练，属于调试用途，界面只提供 off / auto。）

standard_en.summary: Routes the PyTorch optimizer's step through a Triton kernel backend (not the top bar's TurboCore CUDA path). off = the native step; auto = accelerate where supported; force = force it (an error if unsupported). Hard mutual exclusion with the top bar's TurboCore CUDA: when the top bar is on this is forced off.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.off: The optimizer step goes through native PyTorch.
optionDescriptions.auto: Goes through the Lulynx Triton optimizer where conditions allow.
optionDescriptions.force: Forces Triton; it will fail outright if the environment is not up to it. (Not in this selector: force raises and stops training when the native module is missing or the optimizer is unsupported, which is for debugging, so the interface offers only off / auto.)

Hard-mutually-exclusive with top-bar TurboCore CUDA: when the top bar is on, this is forced off.
